environment.description: ASP.NET Core 8 application deployed on AWS ECS Fargate behind an Application Load Balancer with no WAF association. SameSite=None on auth cookies allows cross-origin form submissions. No anti-forgery middleware configured. ALB forwards all POST requests directly to the application. The application is accessible at https://app.example.com with valid TLS certificate.

config.load_balancer: ALB with HTTPS listener, no WAF WebACL associated
config.cors: not configured (defaults allow all origins for form posts)
